subject: Archaeology
title: The Bust of Nefertiti
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Bust of Nefertiti.

hook.text: In 1912, a German team in Egypt uncovered a painted limestone bust so beautiful it stunned the world.

buildup.text: The bust depicted Queen Nefertiti with perfect symmetry and one mysteriously missing eye.

discovery.text: The 3,300-year-old sculpture was found in a sculptor's workshop — likely a model, not a finished piece.

twist.text: Germany took it to Berlin. Egypt has demanded its return for over a century and been refused every time.

climax.text: The bust is now the most visited artifact in Berlin. Egypt calls it a stolen cultural treasure.

punchline.text: A sculptor's rough draft became one of the most fought-over artworks on earth.

quiz.question: What was the Nefertiti bust likely used for originally?
options: It was placed in Nefertiti's tomb as a burial object
It was a sculptor's workshop model, not a finished piece
It was a religious idol worshipped in temples
